<div class="card-body">
'''Chewbacca''' is a [[Light]] [[Character]] ([[Alien]] / [[Rebel]]) from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">チューバッカ</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">ハンと同じ位置カードにいるなら戦闘力＋1。操縦する宇宙船の戦闘力に2を加える。ミレニアム・ファルコンに乗っているならさらに回避値に1を加える。彼と同じ位置カード上のビークルやドロイドは、“命中” しても（ロストデッキのかわりに）ユーズドデッキに行く。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Chewbacca-Encyclopedia32-p42-xref2048.jpeg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">キャッシーク出身のウーキーの密輸屋。200歳を越えている。腕利きの整備士にしてパイロット。ジャバはこの “歩き回るカーペット” にも多額の賞金をかけている。仲間からは “チューイー” とか、“毛むくじゃら” と呼ばれている。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Chewbacca.

'''Card text:'''
Power +1 if at the same location card as Han. Adds 2 to the power of a starship he pilots. If aboard Millennium Falcon, also adds 1 to maneuver. Vehicles and droids on the same location card as him go to the Used Deck (instead of the Lost Deck) even if they are “hit.”

'''Lore:'''
A Wookiee smuggler from Kashyyyk. He is over 200 years old. A skilled mechanic and pilot. Jabba has also placed a large bounty on this “walking carpet.” His companions call him “Chewie” or “Fuzzball.”

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese last sentence names vehicles and droids.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Chewbacca]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
